title: USAF EOS Fieldcraft Training Support Services FY27-FY32
description: The purpose of amendment 0005 to RFP FA448426R0001 is to EXTEND the solicitation closing date from 09 SEP 2026 at 4:00PM to Wednesday, SEPTEMBER 23, 2026 at 4:00PM EST. All other term and conditions of the solicitation remain. _________________________________ The purpose of amendment 0004 is to incorporate Provision/ Clause 52.219-27 Notice of Set-Aside for, or Sole-Source Award to, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Concerns Eligible Under the SDVOSB Program. The Solicitation closing due date is not extended. All other terms or conditions remain the same. __________________________________ The purpose of amendment 0003 is to post answers to vendor questions received. As a result, the following revisions have been made: 1) Addendum 52.212-2(F)(2)(b) has been revised to include "The government will evaluate the price of any possible extension by dividing the price in the last option period by twelve, multiplying that figure by six, and adding it to the total price of the base and all options." 2) Addendum 52.212-2(F)(3)(a) Recency has been revised to remove "up to three (3)" and read as follows: To be determined recent, performance surveys and performance questionnaires received by the government shall reference projects that have been awarded, completed, or are ongoing within five (5) years from the date of this solicitation. 3) Provisions/Clauses R-DFARS 252.204-7021 and 252.204-7025 have been removed. 4) PWS Sec 6 Att. 4. Notional schedule has been updated. 5) Addendum to 52.212-1(a)(E.) Specific Instructions has been updated; Redaction should include company names. logos, and identifying information. 6) Burlington County SCA WD 15-4191 has been updated to Revision 34 dated 22AU26. 7) Attachment 14 - Fieldcraft_FA448426R00010003_Vendor Questions has been added. The Solicitation closing date is not extended. All other terms and conditions remain the same. ___________________________________ The purpose of amendment 0002 to RFP FA448426R0001 is to EXTEND the solicitation closing date from 24 AUG 2026 at 4:00PM to 09 SEP 2026 at 4:00PM. All other term and conditions of the solicitation remain. ____________________________________ The purpose of amendment 0001 to RFP FA448426R0001 is to correct the SF1449 Estimated Quantities in Section B: Supplies or Services & Prices or Costs. The solicitation closing date is not being extended. Notice to Offeror(s)/Supplier(s): Funds are not presently available for this effort. No award will be made under this solicitation until funds are available. The Government reserves the right to cancel this solicitation, either before or after the closing date. In the event the Government cancels this solicitation, the Government has no obligation to reimburse an offeror for any costs. ***Note: A duplicate copy of the PWS is hereby uploaded to remove locked properties of the original copy. No changes to the PWS content have been made. *** EXECUTIVE SUMMARY/ GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS This Executive Summary has been prepared as an aid to you, the potential offeror. The Government has made every effort to accurately reflect the requirements and information contained in this solicitation. However, if there are any inconsistencies between the executive summary and the solicitation, the solicitation will govern. 1. The U.S. Air Force 87 Contracting Squadron (CONS), Joint Base MDL, New Jersey, on behalf of the USAF Expeditionary Center (EC) located on JB-MDL, NJ. has a requirement for providing Fieldcraft Training Support Services in accordance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) (Section 1.2, Attachment 0001) dated 19 MAY 2026. Services shall be provided for one (1) 12-month period plus four (4) 12-month option periods from 12 DEC 2026 � 11 DEC 2031. In addition, the government may extend the total length of the contract by no more than (6) months after the end of the last option year, if necessary, and IAW with RFO 52.217-8. 2. The Government intends to award a single Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Requirements Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). The acquisition is based upon competition to represent the Best Value IAW RFO 15.101 to the Government. For proposal instructions and submittal information, see RFO 52.212-1, entitled Instructions to Offerors � Commercial Products and Commercial Services. For the basis of award, see RFO 52.212-2, entitled Evaluation � Commercial Products and Commercial Services. 3. The contracting officer has determined there is a high probability of adequate price competition in this acquisition. Upon examination of the initial offers, the contracting officer will review this determination and if, in the contracting officer's opinion, adequate price competition exists no additional data will be requested and certification under RFO 15.403-4 will not be required. However, if at any time during this competition the contracting officer determines that adequate price competition no longer exists; offerors may be required to submit cost data to the extent necessary for the contracting officer to determine the reasonableness and affordability of the price. 4. This is an all-electronic solicitation release. Hard copies are not available. The Government will post all information pertaining to the solicitation and award of this requirement to the Government Point of Entry (GPE), also known as SAM.gov. It is the responsibility of each offeror to review the web page for postings of amendments, updates, or changes to current information. 5. Offerors are required to meet all solicitation requirements, such as terms and conditions, representations and certifications, and technical requirements, in addition to those identified as evaluation factors. Failure to meet a requirement may result in an offer being ineligible for award. Offerors must clearly identify any exception to the solicitation terms and conditions and provide complete accompanying rationale. 6. Questions regarding this RFP shall be submitted via email, and subsequent answers will be posted to SAM.gov. If Offerors have questions, they are requested to submit them in writing grouped by solicitation section and make reference to the particular section / subsection number. Questions must be received via email no later than 5 August 2026 at 1600 Eastern Time to both Christina Vargas at christina.vargas.1@us.af.mil and lewis.hampton@us.af.mil. The decision whether to respond to questions and requests for clarification made after Q&A suspense date closing shall be at the sole discretion of the Contracting Officer. Failure of a prospective offeror to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the prospective offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. 7. Clarifications: Clarifications, exchanges of information between Government and offerors, will be controlled by the Contracting Officer. The Government intends to award a contract without negotiations with respective offerors. The Government, however, reserves the right to conduct negotiations if deemed in its best interest. 8. Proposals submitted in response to this RFP must be submitted via email to both Christina Vargas at christina.vargas.1@us.af.mil and lewis.hampton@us.af.mil. Proposals not sent to both addresses will be considered nonresponsive and will not be evaluated forward. To ensure successful delivery, contractors shall obtain confirmation from the Contracting Officer that their proposal has been received and reviewed. Email submissions can occasionally be misplaced or routed to junk folders, so it is the contractor's responsibility to secure direct confirmation from the Contracting Officer that the government has both received and acknowledged their proposal. Failure to obtain email confirmation of receipt from the Government may result in your offer not being received and, consequently, not being evaluated. Late proposals will be processed in accordance with RFO 52.212- 1(c)

title: Air National Guard Readiness Center Cable Television Services
description: AMENDMENT 001: The purpose of this amendment to Solicitation Number W9133L26QA030 is to correct the site visit date to state 26 Sep 2026 and to provide responses to questions received. Please see attached Q&A document. All other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged. Any associated costs necessary to comply with these requirements shall be included in the Firm-Fixed Price offer. The contractor shall provide all necessary personnel, supervision, equipment, materials, transportation, licenses, and retransmission rights necessary to deliver continuous, high-definition (HD) commercial television programming to the existing Haivision distribution system. All work shall be performed in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement.

title: SEI Industries, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), "Premo Fireballs" Aerial Ignition Sphere Dispenser Purchase and Reburbishment
description: SPECIAL NOTICE: 1202SC26Q2718 Description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE The U.S. Forest Service (USFS), Procurement & Property Services (PPS), Incident Procurement Operations (IPO), At Incident Management Support Branch (AIMS), intends to issue a Firm Fixed Priced Purchase Order as authorized by 41 U.S.C. 1901 - FAR 12.201-1, Simplified Procedures, on or about October 1, 2026, to Fire Ignition Resources, LLC, for the USDA Forest Service (USDA-FS). The intent of this requirement is to provide one (1) refurbishment and an estimated five (5) new Premo Fireballs Aerial Ignition Plastic Sphere Dispensers to be used during prescribed burning and wildfire incidents. The Premo MK IIIs are the only aerial ignition devices in USDA-FS inventory and the only aerial ignition device authorized for use by the Wildland Fire Aerial Ignition Operations as directed by the National Wildfire Coordinating Group (NWCG) PMS 501, Chapter 3. By awarding a Purchase Order for the supply of SEI Industries, Premo MK III Plastic Sphere Dispensers through Fire Ignition Resources, LLC, the USDA/Forest Service ensures equipment performance, OEM equipment support, operational reliability, system continuity, operator and equipment safety, and existing factory warranties, while ensuring maximum mission readiness, meeting the strategic objectives of the Wildland Fire Aerial Ignition Operations of our organization. The PPS, IPO, AIMS intends to non-competitively award this requirement to Fire Ignition Resources, LLC. The required items are proprietary to SEI Industries, LLC and the only authorized vendor to provide SEI Industries, Premo MK III dispensers, is Fire Ignition Resources, LLC. Furthermore, Premo MK IIIs are compatible in all aspects with existing SEI Industries systems/equipment presently in use, allowing personnel in the field to maintain continuity of service during fire mission times. No other manufacturer is compatible or can interchange with SEI Industries� proprietary systems without voiding existing warranties and posing safety risks to equipment and operators. As a result, any vendor other than Fire Ignition Resources, LLC capable of providing comparable models would not be approved by the manufacturer or per established USDA-FS equipment approvals. Fire Ignition Resources, LLC is the only source capable of providing the authorized required items to maintain the safety of personnel, equipment, continuity of service, and the uninterrupted operation and mission readiness during fire seasons. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 332994 with the size standard of 1000 employees. This notice of intent is not a request for proposals or quotes. However, all responsible sources may submit an offer and capabilities/narrative that proves by clear and convincing evidence that detail their ability to provide proprietary Premo MK III dispensers authorized by SEI Industries, LLC. If said OFFER and capabilities/narrative is received within fifteen (15) calendar days of publication of this notice, the narrative will be considered by the Contracting Officer. All responses shall be submitted to the Government point of contact at the email address shown below. A determination by the Government not to open the requirement to competition based upon the responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Government Point of Contact: Purchasing Agent Shannon Meadows, shannon.meadows@usda.gov.

description: Acquire one complete, Government-owned 10-foot by 30-foot modular trade-show exhibit for United States Air Force Band outreach and recruiting activities. description: The Defense Logistics Agency-Aberdeen, on behalf of the Army Integrated Logistics Supply Center (ILSC) � Supply Chain Management Directorate (SCMD) � Strategic Sourcing Directorate (SSD), intends to acquire Parts to support the SINCGARS. Requirements Description: This is a market survey to locate sources of supply for NSN 895-01-225-3333 Installation Kit, Electronic Equipment MK-2371/VRC in support of the Single Channel Ground and Airborne Radio System (SINCGARS). SINCGARS is a family of Very High Frequency-Frequency Modulation (VHF-FM) combat net radios designed to provide the primary means of command and control for combat, combat support, and combat service support units. SINCGARS radio provides a resistance to jamming via Electronic Counter-Countermeasures (ECCM). The SINCGARS family of radios has the capability to transmit and receive voice and digital data and is consistent with North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) Interoperability requirements. SINCGARS is the primary soldier-to-soldier communications system and is one of the five major communications/data elements that provide seamless digital communications to the Army end user. SINCGARS Installation Kits (IKs) are designed to install the specified SINCGARS radio configuration into a specified vehicle. Each IK contains different components depending on the SINCGARS radio configuration being installed with the particular IK. Most of the SINCGARS IKs contains Mounting Base, Electrical, MT-6352/VRC; Loudspeaker-Control Unit, LS-671/VRC; Antenna, Vehicular (High Voltage Center-Fed) AS-3900A/VRC; Antenna, Vehicular (Survivable Low Profile), AS-3916/VRC; Handset, H-250/VCEB and Various Cable Assemblies, which are considered to be the major components of these IKs and the hardware. Some of them contain mechanical parts and the hardware only. First Article Test (FAT) will be required for SINCGARS IKs containing electronic components and the FAT will be performed on the major components of the IK as mentioned above, but not on the IK itself. The Installation Kit (NSN 895-01-225-3333) being procured is composed of MT-6352/VRC Mounting Base, AS-3916/VRC Antenna, CG-3855/VRC Cable Assembly, CX-133306 Cable Assembly and the hardware. Therefore, the FAT for this NSN will be performed on the MT-6352/VRC Mounting Base, AS-3916/VRC Antenna and two Cable Assemblies. The manufacturer(s) shall have capability to complete the FAT successfully and commence the delivery within 10 months after the contract award. The Government does possess the technical data package (TDP) for the part. The TDP is available for release. The TDP includes level 3. production information. NSN 5895-01-225-3333 was procured previously under Contract # W15P7T05F0073. Items and/or Services to Be Procured: NSN: 5895-01-225-3333 NOMENCLATURE: Installation Kit, Electronic Equipment MK-2371/VRC PART NUMBER: PPL- 10300 CAGE: 80063 Requested Response Information: We request that sources who can manufacture the listed parts or services to submit information to show their capability to manufacture or supply the same or similar part. At a minimum the support information you submit should include, but is not limited to, the following types of documentation: Questionnaire, detail description of your capability of manufacturing this part and the information regarding the previous Government contracts for this part if you have previously supplied this part to the Government. In your response, please include your company name, CAGE code, and a technical point of contract with email address and telephone number. Notice, Response Due Date, and Points of Contact: This is NOT a Request for Quote or Proposal. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this SSA or reimburse any costs associated with the preparation of responses to this SSA. This Sources sought announcement (SSA) is for planning and market research purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government. The information gathered from this announcement will be used to determine if responsible sources exist, and to assist in determining if this effort can be competitive and/or set aside for Small Business. Furthermore, the Government will use the information, in part, to determine the best acquisition strategy for a potential procurement action and/or to assist in making acquisition strategy decisions in the future. All SSA responses should be emailed to the Points of Contact at the email addresses listed below. No phone inquiries will be accepted, either as a response to this action or for information requests. All requests for information must be submitted via email to the Technical Point of Contact and the DLA Aberdeen Small Business Office. Please submit responses by 9/23/2026 Technical Point of Contact: stanley.u.chan.civ@army.mil DLA Aberdeen Small Business: DLA.Land.and.Maritime.Small.Business.Office@dla.mil

title: Area of Interest (AoI) 021 - TACOM Oral Histories & Imagery Collection (CSO W912CH25SC001)
description: Federal Agency: Army Office: Army Contracting Command � Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA), Command Historian AoI Title: U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command (TACOM) Oral History and Commemoration Project CSO AoI Number: AoI 021 AoI Release Date: 9 September 2026 Responses: See W912CH-25-S-C001, Amendment 01 for Procedure Details 1. General Information 1.1 Introduction This Area of Interest (AoI) is issued utilizing the ACC?DTA Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) W912CH-25-S-C001, Amendment 01. U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command (TACOM) seeks proposals for support services for a robust project to involve the command workforce in collecting and digitally preserving oral histories and imagery, and to deliver an archive of collected oral histories and imagery along with a product or products that are derived from oral histories and imagery, commemorating the 60th year of the organization. This procurement requires the contractor to provide a solution supporting the headquarters (Warren, MI) and all major industrial sites (Anniston, AL; Rock Island, IL; Texarkana, TX; Herlong, CA; Watervliet, NY), with options for participation by members of the workforce at lower density sites (Lima, OH; Natick, MA; Edgewood, MD; Philadelphia, PA; Fort Lee; Fort Jackson; Fort Benning; Fort Leonard Wood), and in extended locations (i.e., deployed or permanently stationed at Army installations outside the continental U.S.). Offerors must provide a detailed narrative demonstrating their organizational capacity and a proven record of delivering effective, efficient services comparable in scope of this requirement. The narrative must include specific examples of service delivery models, internal quality control measures, and a summary of historical performance metrics achieved for clients of comparable size, complexity and specialty. This CSO AoI seeks innovative commercial solutions that meet the objectives detailed in Section 1.2 and 1.3, below. In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) 212.70, the term innovative is defined as any technology, process, or method, including research and development, that is new as of the date of proposal submission, or any new application of an existing technology, process, or method as of the proposal date. CSOs may only be used to obtain innovative solutions or potential capabilities that fulfill requirements; to close capability gaps or provide potential innovative technological advancements; and when meaningful proposals with varying technical or scientific approaches can be reasonably anticipated. ACC-DTA is not obligated to extend a request for proposal or make an award as a result of this CSO AoI; all awards are subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. This CSO AoI is not an authorization to begin performance, and in no way obligates the Government for any costs incurred by the Offeror associated with developing a Response. Prior to commencement of any activities associated with performance under this CSO AoI, the Government will issue a written directive or contractual document signed by the Contracting Officer with appropriate consideration established. ACC-DTA reserves the right to modify the requirements of this CSO AoI. The authority to issue this CSO AoI is derived from ACC-DTA Commercial Solutions Opening W912CH-25-S-C001, dated 10 July 2025. The CSO authority is Section 803 of the National Defense Authorization Act for FY2022, Public Law 117-807, and Class Deviation 2022-O0007. 1.2 AoI Background TACOM�s mission is to deliver materiel readiness and solutions to execute precision sustainment of ground systems for the U.S. Army and the nation. TACOM is a resilient, innovative team that moves at pace and with urgency to generate readiness and solve problems for the Army. TACOM requires support services to collect, preserve, archive, and use oral histories and imagery to commemorate the 60th year of the organization. The period of performance is one (1) twelve-month base year with a six (6) month extension option under FAR 52.217-8. 1.3 Identify AoI Solution The proposed solution shall provide comprehensive capabilities, to include: all personnel, travel, equipment, tools, facilities, materials, supervision, supplies, and non-personal services necessary to schedule, facilitate, audio record, transcribe, and archivally preserve oral history conversations between members of the workforce who know each other (e.g., current, past, any combination). Solutions shall: i) include every major TACOM location and provide options for workforce participation from lower density and extended sites; ii) provide innovative solutions to extend opportunities to every member of the workforce; and iii) reach a maximum number or percentage of the workforce population while representing all ranks, grades, types of work, and generations. Proposed solutions shall include meeting with command representatives to develop project vision and focus, and to identify and address challenges and opportunities. Proposals shall also include the offeror�s capabilities to develop and deliver workshops and curriculum to train command personnel to collect oral history conversations Proposals shall also include the offeror�s capabilities to collect and archivally preserve imagery of and from oral history narrators as well as the broader workforce, with an aim to maximize participation (collected imagery may include formal command portraits of narrators and the broader workforce, informal portraits, or relevant imagery or other content submitted by members of the workforce). Lastly, proposals shall describe capabilities to develop and deliver a derivative product or products available to the entire workforce, commemorating the workforce and the command in its 60th year (such products may be digital exhibits featuring collected audio and imagery, an online archive, a traditional print yearbook, or other innovative solutions). To assist with budgetary packaging, offerors shall provide a non-binding Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) for the total estimated cost of this project, including the twelve-month base year and the twelve-month option year. This information will be used for packaging purposes only and does not constitute a formal pricing proposal. 2. AoI Constraints Any selected company/companies will be required to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov). 3. Requirements (a) Submission: A written solution must be sent via e-mail submission by 5:00 P.M. (EDT/EST) 23 September 2026 with subject line stating TACOM Archival and Volunteer Program Management for AoI 012 TACOM to Point of Contacts (POC) listed below. Solutions received after the specified due date and time will be discarded and will not be evaluated by the Government. AoI Open Period � This AoI will close at 5:00 P.M. (EDT/EST): 23 September 2026 (b) POCs: AoI questions can be sent to: CSO AoI POC: Dr. Rachel Johnstone: rachel.s.johnstone.civ@army.mil Contract Specialist: Mr. Rory Thelen, rory.g.thelen.civ@army.mil Contracting Officer: Ms. Kelsey Greenwell, kelsey.d.greenwell.civ@army.mil

title: SDB T&I and CLS
description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS: 1. NOTICE: This is not a solicitation but rather a Sources Sought Synopsis to determine potential sources for information and planning purposes only. 1.1 The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine if responsible sources exist, to assist in determining if this effort can be competitive and/or a total Small Business Set-Aside. The proposed North American Industry Classification Systems (NAICS) Code is 332993, Ammunition (except Small Arms) Manufacturing, which has a corresponding Size standard of 1500 employees. The Government will use this information to determine the best acquisition strategy for this procurement. The Government is interested in all small businesses to include 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned, Hubzone, and Women-Owned small business concerns. Respondents should indicate their size in relation to this size standard and indicate socio-economic status (i.e. SB, 8(a), HUBZone, EDWOSB, WOSB, or SDVOSB). Respondents are further requested to indicate their status as a Foreign-owned/Foreign-controlled firm and any contemplated use of foreign national employees for this effort along with a description of similar services offered to the Government and to commercial customers for the past three years. Any responses involving teaming agreements should delineate between the work that will be accomplished by the prime and the work accomplished by the teaming partners. 2. Program Details: Required capabilities include Small Diameter Bomb I (SDB I) Aircraft Integration, Test, & Program Support, and Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) throughout the production and sustainment phases. This requirement includes, but is not limited to, all efforts related to SDB I Aircraft Integration, Test, & Program Support and Sustainment which will require the contractor to provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, management, supervision, and other items and nonpersonal services necessary to perform Aircraft Integration, Test, & Program Support and CLS. The SDB I Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) is not required to provide SDB I equipment, supplies, materials or a build-to technical data package (TDP) for this system. 3. Requirements: Under the contemplated contract, the contractor will be required to provide the following in support of SDB I: non-warranted repairs, Operational Safety, Suitability and Effectiveness (OSS&E) testing, technical support for fielded items, WSEP test support, technical order updates, software (SW) and SW integration support, repair or replacement of line replacement units (LRU), program management, operations support, field support, supply chain management, training, technical support, and sustaining engineering. 4. Capabilities Statement: Interested vendors shall submit a capabilities statement that explicitly demonstrates their capability to provide/perform the requirement stated in this notice. The capabilities statement should be brief and concise yet clearly demonstrate an ability to meet the stated requirement. The response must not exceed 15 pages. Small businesses with only partial capabilities of this requirement are encouraged to submit their capabilities statement demonstrating the portion of the requirement they are capable of providing/performing. This information will allow the Government to identify areas of possible breakout or possible subcontracting opportunities. 5. Submission Details: Any information submitted by respondents to this sources sought notice is voluntary. This sources sought notice is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, nor will the Government reimburse any costs associated with the submission of information in response to this notice. Respondents will not be individually notified of the results of any government assessments. The Government�s assessment of the capability statements received will factor into whether any forthcoming solicitation will be conducted as a full and open competition or as a set-aside for small business, or any particular small business program. Responses may be submitted electronically to the e-mail addresses below. All correspondence sent via email shall contain a subject line that reads �SDB I � CLS and T&I�. If this subject line is not included, the e-mail may not get through e-mail filters at Hill AFB. Filters are designed to delete emails without a subject or with a suspicious subject or attachment. Attachments with files ending in .zip or .exe are not allowable and will be deleted. Ensure only .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xsls, or .xls documents are attached to your email. All other attachments may be deleted. Proposals are not being requested or accepted at this time. Responses to this notice are not considered offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. No solicitation (Request for Proposal) exists currently; therefore, do not request a copy of the solicitation. The decision to solicit a contract shall be solely within the Government�s discretion. RESPONSES ARE DUE NO LATER THAN 3:00 P.M. (MDT) ON 23 September 2026. Direct all questions concerning this requirement to Jason Lema at jason.lema@us.af.mil and Deric Deede at deric.deede@us.af.mil.

title: Germany – Public road transport services – Vergabe von Personenbeförderungsleistungen im Linienverkehr mit Kraftfahrzeugen in dem Landkreis Böblingen, Verkehrsraum Linienbündel BB03 "Nördliches Heckengäu"
description: Der öffentliche Auftraggeber ist der zuständige Aufgabenträger im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr (ÖPNV) nach § 8 Abs. 3 Satz 1 PBefG i. V. m. § 6 Abs. 1 des Gesetzes über die Planung, Organisation und Gestaltung des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs Baden-Württemberg (ÖPNVG BW). Der Auftraggeber ist gem. § 6 Abs. 3 ÖPNVG BW damit auch zuständige Behörde im Sinne der EU-Verordnung (EG) Nr. 1370/2007 (VO 1370/2007). Der Landkreis ist damit für die Sicherstellung eines ausreichenden Verkehrsangebots in seinem Wirkungskreis zuständig (§ 8 Abs. 3 PBefG). Nachdem die aktuelle Verkehrsbedienung im Linienbündel BB03 zum 30.06.2027 endet, war die Verkehrsleistung ab dem 01.07.2027 zu gewährleisten, mithin neu auszuschreiben. Zur Vergabe kommen die Busverkehrsleistungen auf den nachfolgenden aufgelisteten VVS-Linien: - Linie 636 Weissach - Flacht - Perouse - Rutesheim - Renningen - Linie 637 Renningen Süd - Bf - Robert-Bosch-Campus - Malmsheim (- Rutesheim) Bei den o.g. Busverkehrsleistungen handelt es sich um Linienverkehre, die nach § 42 PBefG genehmigt werden sollen. Der Auftragnehmer hat den vorgegebenen Fahrplan zu erfüllen; dieser ist in Anhang LB.1 beigefügt. In Anhang LB.2 und Anhang LB.3 finden sich die zugehörigen Planungshilfen. Zu beachten ist, dass eine Option auf der Linie 637 zur Ausschreibung kommt. In der Option werden zusätzliche Fahrten zwischen Renningen Bahnhof und dem Robert-Bosch-Campus angeboten. Im Rahmen der Inbetriebnahme des Eisenbahninfrastrukturprojektes Stuttgart 21 (S21) kann es zu Verschiebungen im S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehr kommen. Die Deutsche Bahn hat im Juni 2026 eine stufenweise Inbetriebnahme ab vrsl. Dezember 2031 angekündigt. Daher sind die vorgegebenen Busfahrpläne nach Umstellung der S-Bahn- und/oder Regionalverkehre durch den Auftragnehmer auf Kompatibilität mit den dann geltenden S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehrsfahrplänen zu überprüfen. Mögliche Anpassungen sind mit dem Aufgabenträger und ggf. dem VVS rechtzeitig abzustimmen und umzusetzen. Das Letztentscheidungsrecht hat der Aufgabenträger. Der Auftraggeber stellt klar, dass es sich bei dem beschriebenen Mechanismus um Optionen im Sinne des § 132 Abs. 2 S. 1 Nr. 1 GWB handelt, welche im Falle einer, auch späteren, Inbetriebnahme von S 21 eine Auftragsänderung ohne Neuausschreibung ermöglichen. Die Auftragsvergabe fällt in den Anwendungsbereich der Richtlinie 2009/33/EG des Europäischen Parlaments und des Rates (Richtlinie zur Förderung sauberer Fahrzeuge — CVD). Näheres ist Ziff. 5.1. zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Repair and maintenance services – Wartung und Instandsetzung Türen auf dem Gelände des UKE Hamburg-Eppendorf
description: Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die fachgerechte Wartung, Inspektion, Prüfung, Instandsetzung so-wie Störungsbeseitigung an Türanlagen in einem Klinikbetrieb. Ziel ist die Sicherstellung eines sicheren, störungsfreien und rechtskonformen Betriebs sämtlicher Türsysteme unter Berücksichtigung der besonderen Anforderungen eines Krankenhauses an Hygiene, Verfügbarkeit, Personen- und Brandschutz. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere: - Durchführung der regelmäßigen Wartung und Inspektion gemäß den Herstellerangaben, den einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften sowie den geltenden technischen Regelwerken. - Funktionsprüfung, Reinigung, Schmierung, Einstellung und Justierung aller relevanten Bauteile. - Prüfung der Sicherheits- und Schutzeinrichtungen einschließlich Sensoren, Verriegelungen, Schließfolgeregler, Fluchtwegfunktionen sowie Notöffnungs- und Entriegelungseinrichtungen. - Instandsetzung schadhafter oder verschlissener Komponenten einschließlich Lieferung und Einbau geeigneter Ersatzteile nach vorheriger Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber. - Durchführung der gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Prüfungen und Dokumentation sämtlicher Wartungs-, Prüf- und Instandsetzungsmaßnahmen. Die Leistungen beziehen sich insbesondere auf: - automatische Schiebe- und Drehtüranlagen, - Brandschutz- und Rauchschutztüren, - Flucht- und Rettungswegtüren, - Feststellanlagen, - kraftbetätigte Türen, - Schleusen- und Zugangssysteme sowie - weitere im Objekt vorhandene Türanlagen. Die Arbeiten sind so zu planen und auszuführen, dass Beeinträchtigungen des laufenden Klinikbetriebs auf ein Mindestmaß reduziert werden. Bereiche mit Patientenversorgung, Intensivmedizin, OP-Betrieb sowie sonstige sicherheitsrelevante Bereiche sind unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der betrieblichen Abläufe zu behandeln. Erforderliche Arbeiten außerhalb der regulären Betriebszeiten sind nach Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber durchzuführen. Der Auftragnehmer stellt sicher, dass ausschließlich qualifiziertes und für die jeweiligen Türsysteme geschultes Fachpersonal eingesetzt wird. Eingebaute Ersatzteile müssen den Herstellervorgaben entsprechen oder technisch gleichwertig sein und alle sicherheitsrelevanten Anforderungen erfüllen. Nach jeder Wartung und Instandsetzung ist ein Wartungs- bzw. Prüfprotokoll mit Angaben zu den durchgeführten Arbeiten, festgestellten Mängeln, empfohlenen Maßnahmen sowie gegebenenfalls ausgetauschten Bauteilen zu übergeben. Festgestellte sicherheitsrelevante Mängel sind dem Auftraggeber unverzüglich anzuzeigen. Die Leistungen umfassen sämtliche erforderlichen Nebenleistungen, die für eine ordnungsgemäße, betriebs- und funktionssichere Ausführung notwendig sind.

buyer: European Commission, DG JRC - Joint Research Centre
title: Italy – Gas generators – Supply, Installation and maintenance of a PEM Electrolyser for Hydrogen Production at JRC Ispra
description: The procurement entails the design, manufacturing, delivery, installation, and commissioning of a Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) electrolysis system for hydrogen production at the JRC Ispra site. The core of the system is a 50 Nm3/h electrolyser (which must be upgradable to 100 Nm3/h) that delivers hydrogen at an outlet pressure of 30 barg. The main equipment will be delivered in a containerized/skid version divided into three specific areas: a control panel area with the AC/DC converter, a water purification unit, and an ATEX­classified area containing the stacks and gas purification treatment. In addition to the containerized unit, the scope of supply includes several external components: ­ An MV/LV transformer ­ A thermal management system (dry cooler) ­ A low­pressure hydrogen storage system consisting of a cylinder rack at 30 bar with a total volume of 5 m3 ­ A gas blender installed on the outlet piping after the storage Finally, the procurement includes a comprehensive service package covering the Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT), ATEX verification, staff training, two years of spare parts, and a 3­year maintenance contract. Reason for Purchasing The primary objective of this procurement is to produce green hydrogen by harnessing the renewable energy generated from the JRC Ispra site's internal photovoltaic (PV) plant. Currently, the site has a 1.35 MWp PV installation, which is planned to be expanded to 2 MWp and eventually 3 MWp in the future. Instead of using battery systems, the JRC intends to use the excess energy from this PV plant to power the electrolyser for self­consumption. The hydrogen produced will then be blended into the natural gas pipeline (up to a 10% volume blend) to feed the site's co­generators. A dedicated technical sizing analysis concluded that a modular 2x250 kW electrolyser is the optimal choice, as it offers the best compromise between the available PV power, the number of operating hours, and the demand from the co­generators across current and future PV expansion scenarios

title: Germany – Engineering design services – Schöpfwerk Niendorf - Ersatzneubau
description: Der NLWKN möchte die Planungsleistungen für den Ersatzneubau des Schöpfwerks Niendorf (Amt Neuhaus) mit den Losen 1 "Umweltplanung" und 2 "Ingenieurbauwerk" vergeben. Nähere Informationen entnehmen sie bitte den beiliegenden Bewerbungsbedingungen mit Anlagen sowie der Leistungsbeschreibung. Das Vergabeverfahren wird als "Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb" nach § 17 Vergabeverordnung (VgV) durchgeführt. Über das Vergabeportal des Landes Niedersachsen können Sie sich nun im Rahmen des Teilnahmewettbewerbs um die Teilnahme am Verhandlungsverfahren bewerben. Füllen Sie hierfür bitte die unter dem Reiter "Teilnehmerunterlagen" hochgeladenen Unterlagen zum Teilnahmewettbewerb aus und laden Sie die geforderten Unterlagen im Vergabeportal hoch. Eine Auflistung der vorzulegenden Bewerbungsunterlagen finden sie in Anlage 2 Bewerbungsbogen unter der Nummer 1.3. Das Schöpfwerk Niendorf wurde in den 1960ern in der DDR errichtet und entwässert das Einzugsgebiet der Krainke mit etwa 12.240 ha. Es schützt dadurch Siedlungsgebiete und landwirtschaftliche Flächen bei Elbehochwasser und Rückstau in die Sude oder bei Eigenhochwasser der Sude. Der am Schöpfwerk angeschlossene rechte Krainkedeich wurde im Jahr 2014 auf die Höhe des neuen Bemessungshochwassers angepasst. Die Sanierung und höhenmäßige Anpassung des linken Krainkedeiches erfolgte im Jahr 2016. Eine Anpassung an die neuen Bemessungswasserstände ist im Bereich des Schöpfwerkes noch nicht erfolgt, so dass Minderhöhen von 30 cm vorhanden sind. Sechs installierte Propellerpumpen verfügen über eine Gesamtleistung von etwa 11,7 m³/s, die Pumpen stammen aus der Zeit des Baues von 1963 und befinden sich Teils in schlechtem Zustand, zwei Pumpen wurden 2005 und 2006 erneuert. Eine Rechenreinigungsanlage ist nicht vorhanden. Daneben verfügt das Schöpfwerk über 4 Freiflutkanäle, die der regulären Entwässerung außerhalb der Hochwasserzeiten dienen, wobei diese nicht den Anforderungen an die Durchgängigkeit nach WRRL genügen. Im Jahre 2016 wurde eine Bedarfsplanung erstellt, mit dem Ergebnis eine Grundinstandsetzung vorzunehmen. Für die Planung der Grundinstandsetzung wurden seit 2021 Ingenieurplanungen der Leistungsphasen 1 bis 3 und Teilen von 4 erbracht. Im Rahmen der Planungen wurden verschiedene Bauteile des Schöpfwerkes näher untersucht: Beton, Putz, Druckrohrleitungen, Schmutzwasserkanal, etc.. Das Ergebnis der Planungen zeigte, dass annähernd sämtliche Anlagenteile des Schöpfwerkes saniert, ausgetauscht oder neu gebaut werden müssten. Aufgrund des absehbaren umfangreichen Instandsetzungsaufwands wurde 2025 im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie untersucht, ob ein Ersatzneubau des Schöpfwerks eine technisch und wirtschaftlich bessere Lösung darstellen kann als eine Sanierung des Bestandes. Der NLWKN beabsichtigt auf Grundlage der bisherigen Planungen und der Ergebnisse der Machbarkeitsstudie aus 2025 das bestehende Schöpfwerk durch einen zeitgemäßen Neubau, am Standort des bestehenden Schöpfwerks zu ersetzen. Der Schöpfwerksneubau soll die aktuellen Anforderungen beim Bemessungswasserstand, der Durchgängigkeit und dem fischfreundlichen und wirtschaftlichen Betrieb erfüllen. Zudem soll durch eine Erhöhung der Pumpenkapazität dem Klimawandel Rechnung getragen werden. Folgende Binnenwasserstände sind durch das Schöpfwerk sicherzustellen: - höchstzulässiger Binnenpeil: +7,80 mNHN - höchster Winterpeil +7,70 mNHN - höchster Sommerpeil +7,40 mNHN - tiefster Binnenpeil +7,20 mNHN Das Bemessungshochwasser liegt derzeit bei 10,60 m+NHN und die entsprechende Ausbauhöhe des Deiches unter Berücksichtigung eines Freibordes von 70 cm bei +11,30 mNHN. Die im folgenden aufgeführten Abflüsse sind durch die Pumpen des Schöpfwerkes abzuführen, sofern der Außenwasserstand über dem Binnenwasserstand liegt: - Höchster Hochwasserabfluss HHQ: 11,142 m³/s - Bemessungshochwasserabfluss: 11,30 m³/s - Bemessungshochwasserabfluss mit Berücksichtigung Klimaanpassungsfaktor: 13,715 m³/s - Sommermittelwasserabfluss SMQ: 2,076 m³/s Die Pumpen müssen auf geodätische Förderhöhen zwischen 0,00 m und 3,20 m ausgelegt werden. Diese Randbedingungen sind auch bei der Planung der Freiflut und der damit verbunden Fischaufstiegsanlage zur Sicherstellung der Binnenpeile und der Durchgängigkeit zu berücksichtigen. Das derzeitige Schöpfwerk Niendorf liegt in diversen naturschutzrechtlich geschützten Gebieten: - Biosphärenreservat "Niedersächsische Elbtalaue" (Lage des technischen Bauwerkes innerhalb des Gebietsteiles A, unmittelbar angrenzend an den streng geschützten Gebietsteil C) - FFH-Gebiet "Elbeniederung zwischen Schnackenburg und Geesthacht" - EU-Vogelschutzgebiet "Niedersächsische Mittelelbe" (Lage des technischen Bauwerkes außerhalb des EU-Vogelschutzgebietes, jedoch unmittelbar an das EU-Vogelschutzgebiet angrenzend) - Kohärenzsicherungsmaßnahme für die Fischarten Bitterling und Steinbeißer im unmittelbaren Umfeld Die entsprechenden Schutzgebietsvorschriften sind bei der Planung zu berücksichtigen.

title: Germany – Business development consultancy services – 10040388-Consulting Services for Fostering a Just Transition in the Mexican Industrial Sector
description: The project "Supporting a Just Transition in Mexico" aims to strengthen the capacities of key public, private and civil society actors to design and implement socially just decarbonization processes in strategic sectors of the Mexican economy, with a particular focus in key industrial (incl. industrial parks) and the energy sector. The project is commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by GIZ, with the Mexican Ministry of Economy (SE) as technical partner. It contributes to the BMZ core theme "Climate and energy", to Mexico's implementation of the Paris Agreement and Agenda 2030 SDGs 13, 9, 7, 5, 16 and 17. Mexico's export-oriented industrial model, the rapid expansion of industrial parks and rising energy demand create pressure and opportunities for low-carbon transformation. Building on the updated climate targets set out in Mexico's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), the country faces the challenge of turning these commitments into coherent implementation. Regulatory gaps, insufficient technical and financial capacities, and social and gender inequalities still limit progress towards a decarbonised economy. The project responds to these challenges by promoting an integrated approach that combines climate protection, industrial competitiveness and social justice. The overall objective is to strengthen the capacities of key actors to implement just transition processes in strategic sectors of the Mexican economy. To achieve this, the project supports the development of participatory governance frameworks for a just transition. Multistakeholder dialogue formats will foster coordination between federal and subnational authorities, the private sector, financial institutions, workers' representatives and civil society organisations. At the meso and micro levels, the project aims to improve the enabling conditions for the adoption of green technologies by companies and industrial parks in selected sectors. This includes technical and economic feasibility studies, advisory services on energy-efficient and renewable energy solutions, and targeted capacity development for park operators, firms and service providers, with special attention to SMEs and the qualification of women and groups in vulnerable situations for future-oriented jobs. In addition, the project works with public development banks and other financial institutions to align their product portfolios with the needs of companies and park operators investing in green technologies and sustainable infrastructure. Together with these actors, it promotes demand-oriented "just transition finance" instruments that are consistent with Mexico's emerging sustainable finance taxonomy and that can be deployed in and around industrial parks, among other industry sectors. The project also supports the design and implementation of social and gender justice strategies in at least one subnational context. Together with public institutions, private sector actors and social partners, it will pilot mechanisms to identify and mitigate negative social impacts of industrial transformation, and to ensure that women and other groups in vulnerable situations benefit from new economic opportunities. Lessons learned will be documented and shared with key institutions across the country to enable replication in additional industrial parks and regions. By 2028, the project expects that several just transition-oriented policy and regulatory instruments have been adopted; that industrial parks and companies in prioritised sectors have taken investment decisions leading to measurable GHG emission reductions; that financial institutions provide suitable financing instruments for such investments; and that institutions in other regions make use of the experience gained with social and gender justice approaches in the Mexican just transition. The project is implemented from October 2024 to September 2028.

Produkterna kan komma att beställas för exempelvis uppvaktningar vid födelsedagar, pensionsavgångar, avtackningar och kondoleanser samt för användning i Upphandlande myndighets verksamheter. Upphandlande myndighet avser att teckna avtal med flera leverantörer inom respektive anbudsdel för att säkerställa god geografisk täckning, tillgänglighet och valmöjligheter för beställarna. Avrop kommer att genomföras utifrån det aktuella behovet och kan därför ske från den leverantör som för det enskilda inköpet bedöms vara mest lämplig med hänsyn till exempelvis sortiment, tillgänglighet, leveransförutsättningar och övriga för uppdraget relevanta omständigheter. Upphandlingen består av två (2) anbudsdelar. Anbudsgivare kan välja att lämna anbud på en (1) eller båda (2) anbudsdelarna. Det finns inget krav på att lämna anbud på samtliga anbudsdelar. 1. Buketter, snittblommor, krukväxter. Leverantören ska erbjuda leverans av buketter, snittblommor, krukväxter samt blomsterarrangemang. Leverantören ska ha ett brett sortiment av blombuketter och blomsterarrangemang i varierande utformning, avsedda för uppvaktning vid exempelvis födelsedagar, pensionsavgångar, avtackningar, kondoleanser samt liknande tillfällen. 2. Fröer och mindre utomhusodling Leverantören ska ha ett brett sortiment av fröer, planteringsjord, krukväxter av enklare slag (ej exklusiva floristprodukter), konstväxt och mindre utomhusodling så som lökar och penséer samt motsvarande varor under hela avtalstiden. Produkter inom detta avtalsområde kan i vissa fall även förekomma inom andra avtal som beställaren har tecknat. Beställaren förbehåller sig rätten att avropa från det avtal som bedöms vara mest ändamålsenligt för det aktuella behovet.

Access will not be granted with out a RSVP. QUESTIONS: Any and all questions regarding this solicitation shall be submitted in writing to the Contract Specialist at patrick.r.gittings@uscg.mil with solicitation RFQ number 70Z03326Q201900012 in subject line. Questions regarding the statement of work (SOW) will be forwarded to the technical expert for an accurate response. All responses will be uploaded for an equal and fair solicitation to all interested vendors solely on SAM.gov. No more questions will be answered after 3:00 PM PDT on September 18th, 2026. SUBMISSION OF QUOTES: Prohibition on Extraneous Material: Do not submit any unnecessary documents, promotional marketing materials, general company history brochures, or generic cover letters. A complete submission shall consist of the following three parts: Part 1: SF 1442 - TOTAL PRICE PROPOSAL 1. Complete and sign the provided Standard Form (SF) 1442. 2. (2-pages maximum) Part 3: Terms & Conditions Complete the necessary fill-ins and certifications in Sections B through K. Submit quotes to the following e-mail address by the offer due date and time zone: Attn: Patrick R. Gittings, E-Mail Address: patrick.r.gittings@uscg.mil with solicitation RFQ number 70Z03326Q201900012 in subject line. It is the government�s intent to award to the offeror who proposes a price that is fair and reasonable and provides the lowest priced, technically acceptable (LPTA) quote meeting the specifications of the requirement. If the lowest priced quote is not found to be technically acceptable, the contracting officer will evaluate the next lowest priced quote, and so on. Quotes determined to be incomplete, unreasonable, or unrealistic will not be considered for award. Under FAR 4.1103 prospective contractor shall be registered in System Award Management (SAM) prior to award. Failure for contractor to be registered in SAM shall result in Contracting Officer to proceed with next successful registered offeror. Website: www.sam.gov.

Los servicios o trabajos efectuados se acreditarán mediante certificados expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público; cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por éste o, a falta de este certificado, mediante una declaración del empresario acompañado de los documentos obrantes en poder del mismo que acrediten la realización de la prestación; en su caso, estos certificados serán comunicados directamente al órgano de contratación por la autoridad competente. Para determinar que un trabajo o servicio es de igual o similar naturaleza se atenderá a la coincidencia de los dos primeros dígitos de los respectivos códigos de la CPV. Las empresas licitadoras deberán estar en posesión de la acreditación que para las empresas proveedoras de servicios determina la legislación vigente en materia de atención a las personas en situación de dependencia. (ORDEN FAM/219/2017, de 20 de marzo, por la que se regula la acreditación del Servicio de Ayuda a Domicilio en Castilla y León). title: Finland – Cleaning and sanitation services – Laitoshuoltopalvelujen hankinta Helsingin, Espoon, Hyvinkään, Vantaan, Sipoon, Järvenpään ja Nurmijärven kohteisiin
description: Hankinnan kohteena on laitoshuoltopalvelut Helsingin, Espoon, Hyvinkään, Vantaan, Sipoon, Järvenpään ja Nurmijärven kohteisiin. Hankintaan sisältyy ylläpitosiivousta, perussiivousta sekä ikkunoiden ja välilasien pesua. Tarjoaja voi tarjota laitoshuoltopalveluja valintansa mukaan joko yhdelle tai useammalle osa-alueelle 1. Pohjois-Uusimaa 2. Gradus ja Fokus 3. Länsi-Itä 4. Järvenpää 5. Espoo 6. Vantaa ja Sipoo 7. Helsinki-Pohjoinen 8. Pasila 9. Kanta Kaupunki KOHTEIDEN NÄYTÖT: HUS järjestää jokaiseen kohteeseen yhden näytön. Vahva suositus on, että tarjoaja osallistuu näyttöihin onnistuneen palvelutuotannon varmistamiseksi. Näytöt keskittyvät ainoastaan kohteen tilojen esittelyyn, joten tarjoajien tulee esittää mahdolliset lisätietokysymykset Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalin kautta niille asetetussa määräajassa. Kohteet, joihin tarjoajat haluavat tutustua, on ilmoitettava 25.8.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä kaikkiin seuraaviin sähköpostiosoitteisiin: vesa.rautiainen@hus.fi, jenni.j.laakkonen@hus.fi. Tarjoajien tulee ilmoittaa sähköpostiviestissä näyttöön osallistuvan yrityksen nimi, yhteystiedot ja sähköpostiosoite, johon kohteiden tarkemmat näyttöaikataulut lähetetään. Kohteet on listattu osoitteineen liitteellä 4. Tilaluettelo. Näytöt ajoittuvat viikolle 36. Näytöt järjestetään (1.9-4.9.2026). Näyttöjen tarkat päivämäärät ilmoitetaan erikseen. Tämän hetken arvio palvelun aloitusajankohdasta on 1.2.2027. Hankinta on kuvattu tarkemmin hankinta-asiakirjoissa. Tilaaja valitsee yhden (1) Palveluntuottajan per osa-alue, jonka kanssa se tekee sopimuksen. Sopimuskausi on ensimmäisen (1) vuoden määräaikainen. Tämän jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo (alv 0%) on noin 7 720 000 euroa. Kyse on arviosta, eikä hankintayksikkö sitoudu ilmoitettuihin euromääriin.

title: Netherlands – Foul-water piping construction work – Kleinschalige herstelwerken Regieteam afval-en hemelwater
description: De opdracht betreft een RAW-Raamovereenkomst voor 4 jaar met daarin opgenomen het repareren, verwijderen en aanleggen van hemelwater- en afvalwaterriolen met een diameter tot en met Ø 250 mm inclusief bijbehorende en daaruit voortvloeiende bijkomende werkzaamheden. Alle werkzaamheden aan het riool vinden plaats binnen de grenzen van gemeente Amsterdam. De aannemer moet fungeren als vangnet bij capaciteits- en bezettingsproblemen, zodat continuïteit en kwaliteit van het rioolonderhoud gewaarborgd blijven. De aannemer zal opereren als verlengstuk van het Regieteam afval- en hemelwater, op basis van korte resultaatafspraken en afgebakende opdrachten.

title: Denmark – Printed matter and related products – Udbud af kontrakt vedrørende levering af biometriske adgangskort
description: Udlændingestyrelsen skal købe biometriske adgangskort til brug for registrering af en beboer på et udrejsecenters overholdelse af opholds- og/eller meldepligt. Adgangskortene skal indeholde beboerens fingeraftryk i krypteret form, og adgangskortene må kun kunne benyttes af beboeren, hvis biometri er optaget på adgangskortet. Kontrakten omfatter levering af de biometriske adgangskort, herunder stregkodekort, kortlæsere og kortudstedelsesudstyr, samt oplæring af medarbejdere i forbindelse med ibrugtagning af den tekniske løsning. Den udbudte kontrakt er ikke opdelt i delkontrakter, jf. udbudslovens § 49, stk. 2, da ordregiver ud fra kontraktgenstanden vurderer, at kontrakten ikke er egnet til opdeling, da der er tale om levering af biometriske adgangskort og stregkodekort til én adresse hos ordregiver.

See the tender invitation and other competition documents for further information.

title: Finland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Support tool for doctoral journey
description: The object of the procurement is a system for monitoring the progress of doctoral studies for the use of the University of Eastern Finland, University of Lapland, University of Vaasa and Åbo Akademi University as a SaaS service and the services associated with it. The object of the procurement consists of the following: -Software service and its user support, covering the system for monitoring progress in doctoral studies that is the object of the procurement as a software service (later referred to as the SaaS) and its user support, including support services for both the Contracting Entity’s representatives and end users. -The object of the procurement also includes the right to extend the SaaS with new add-ons and services. -SaaS deployment covering all tasks that need to be completed in order to start using the SaaS and its user support, including configurations and integrations required for each university. The most common interface terminology can be found in the specification document. The deployment will take place in two phases. In the first phase, support for the doctoral dissertation path will be deployed up till the pre-examination stage, and in the second phase, support for the pre-examination process will be deployed. -Other expert services, including those needed in addition to the ones mentioned above.

title: Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Paloheinän Palvelukeskuksen rakennuttaja- ja valvontapalvelut
description: TAUSTAA Kiinteistö Oy Paloheinän Palvelukeskus (jäljempänä "Hankintayksikkö") hallinnoi ja ylläpitää osoitteessa Paloheinäntie 22, 00670 Helsinki kiinteistöä, jossa toimivassa Paloheinän palvelukeskuksessa sijaitsevat mm. Paloheinäin terveyskeskus, neuvola, hammashoitola sekä Paloheinän kirjasto. Kiinteistössä on todettu akuutteja korjaustarpeita, joiden osalta käynnissä on saneerauksen tarveselvitys. Saneerauksen hankesuunnitteluvaihe on parhaillaan käynnistymässä. Kiinteistön akuutit korjaustarpeet liittyvät mm. • IV järjestelmiin; • vesikaton vesikouruihin ja syöksytorviin; • julkisivuelementtien pinnoitteisiin, saumauksiin sekä betoniterästen korroosion aiheuttamiin betonivaurioihin; • IV konehuoneiden seinärakenteisiin; • ikkunoihin ja oviin; • sisätilojen alakattoihin; sekä • yleisvalaistukseen sisällä ja ulkona. Kiinteistölle tehdään laaja haitta-ainekartoitus. Kiinteistöyhtiön tulee saattaa tilat kuntoon henkilöstön turvallisten työolosuhteiden varmistamiseksi. Kiinteistön kuntoa on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä "7 Paloheinän Palvelukeskus - Kuntoarvio ja PTS". HANKINNAN KOHDE Hankinnan kohteena on Paloheinän Palvelukeskuksen rakennuttajakonsultti- ja valontapalvelut koskien edellä mainittuja korjaustarpeita. Hankittaviin palveluihin kuuluvat rakennuttajakonsultin palvelut. Rakennuttajakonsultin tehtävänä on urakan hankesuunnitteluvaiheen läpivienti yhdessä tilaajan kanssa. Rakennuttajakonsultin tehtäviin kuuluu mm. rakennesuunnittelu-, LVI-suunnittelu- ja sähkösuunnittelupalveluiden kilpailuttaminen. Tarkoituksena on myös tehdä hankesuunnitelma. Palveluntuottaja vastaa hankintayksikön projektinjohtotehtävistä, kuten urakan hankesuunnitteluvaiheeseen osallistuvien toimijoiden välisen tehtävänjaon määrittämisestä, aikataulutuksesta, ohjauksesta sekä tiedottamisesta. Palveluntuottaja toimii koko sopimuskauden ajan hankintayksikön edun ja hankkeelle asetettavien tavoitteiden toteutumisen valvojana ja pitää osaltaan huolen siitä, että urakka suoritetaan voimassa olevan lainsäädännön sekä hankintasopimuksen mukaisesti. Palveluntuottajan tehtävä on erityisesti valvoa hankkeelle asetetun aikataulun ja budjetin onnistumista ja tiedottaa hankintayksikköä välittömästi havaitsemistaan riskeistä aikataulun, laadun tai budjetin osalta sekä antaa hankintayksikölle toimintasuunnitelma kyseisen riskin poistamiseksi tai sen vaikutusten minimoimiseksi. Hankintaan kuuluu pakollisena optiona edellä mainitut rakennuttajakonsultin palvelut sekä rakennusurakan, LVIA-urakan sekä sähköurakan työmaavalvontapalvelut urakan totetussuunnitteluvaiheeseen sekä mahdollisiin hankesuunnitteluvaiheen ja totetutussuunnitteluvaiheen välisiin vaiheisiin koko rakennusurakan keston ajan aina takuukorjausten valvontaan saakka. Rakennuttajakonsultin sekä työmaavalvojien tehtävät on tarkemmin yksilöity tässä tarjouspyynnössä sekä muussa tarjouspyyntömateriaalissa. Palveluihin kuuluvat tehtävät on yksilöity tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa tehtäväluetteloissa: hankkeen johtamisen ja rakennuttamisen tehtäväluettelossa HJR18, talonrakennustöiden työmaavalvonnan tehtäväluettelossa RT 103171 ja talotekniikkatöiden työmaavalvonnan tehtäväluettelossa RT 103172. Tehtäväluetteloiden rajaukset on mainittu kohdassa "Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit" --> "Yhteiset kriteerit/tiedot". Valitulla palveluntuottajalla tulee olla tarvittavat työvälineet ja -tilat palvelun järjestämiseen. Hankintayksikkö ei tuota ja tarjoa palveluntuottajalle työtilaa hankinnan kohteena olevan palvelun toteuttamiseen. Hankintamenettelyn lopputuloksena Hankintayksikkö valitsee yhden (1) palveluntuottajan, jonka kanssa se tekee hankintasopimuksen. Hankinta ei sisällä määräostovelvoitetta, eikä tuota valituille palveluntuottajalle yksinoikeutta palveluiden tuottamiseen. Tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen sisältämät mahdolliset arviot palveluntarpeesta perustuvat hankinnan valmisteluhetken tilanteeseen ja voivat muuttua sopimuskauden aikana. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa mahdollisesti esitettyihin arvioihin hankintamääristä. Hankintayksikkö tilaa palveluja tarpeensa mukaan tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa kuvatulla tavalla.

Hankintaan ei sisälly vähimmäisostovelvoitetta. Hankintayksikkönä ja ainoana sopimuskumppanina valitulle toimittajalle toimii tässä hankinnassa Oy Apotti Ab. Hankinnasta on järjestetty hankintamenettelyä edeltävä hankintalain 65 § mukainen markkinakartoitus ja siitä on julkaistu ilmoitus HILMA-portaalissa. Katso tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevat asiakirjat saadaksesi lisätietoja.

title: Kirtland Air Force Base (KAFB) Base Supply
description: The contractor shall, except as specified in the Performance Work Statement (PWS) as Government property or services, provide all personnel, supervision, and any items and services necessary to perform the requirements in this PWS and conform to the professional standards identified in this contract and shall follow all applicable instructions and directives as identified by this PWS. Contractor tasks include the following: The contractor will operate and maintain the base supply services, which will provide a full spectrum of transparent supply chain management service. These supply chain management activities include, but are not limited to: managing supply and demand, sourcing parts, part disposal coordination, warehousing and inventory tracking, order management, equipment management, Individual Protection Equipment, parts pickup, Mission Capability and After hours support, Bench stock ordering, Individual Equipment, Document Control, Hazardous Materiel, Flight Service Center Functions, Receiving, Weapons Management, Information Technology, Network/system administration, and desktop support. Supply Chain Support Services operate primarily at KAFB. Support is required for off-site locations includes, but is not limited to Equipment Accountability Element support.
